name: Module 1: culture
source: PLACEHOLDER. Part layout from the Module 1 design brief; culture at 37 C (CapSeq / SPC-NAR, contracts/parameters.json culture.temp_c). No lab protocol values: every reagent, volume and time is a generic placeholder.
description: Seed, separate the three lanes, differentiate with batch medium exchanges, label each chamber, sample the supernatant, (interaction variant: let the chambers signal to each other), sample again, detach and harvest. Same protocol for both chip instances; steps marked with a variant run only in that variant. Timeline compressed in the twin with a day counter.

steps.note: Open the three branch valves so cells can reach the culture chambers.
Load the cells (expanded off-chip) into the seeding chamber.
The cells flow through the split into the three culture chambers.
Close the branch valves: from now on each chamber is its own lane.
Differentiate. Once a day (placeholder) a batch of each lane's own medium and factor flows through its chamber, then the flow stops until the next change. 14 days (placeholder).
Label each chamber with its own label, so cells from different chambers can be pooled later and still told apart.
Interaction variant only: open the pair valves so signals can pass between the chambers through the microgrooves.

Interaction period, 3 days (placeholder). Interaction chip: the pair valves are open and the cell types signal to each other. Control chip: the valves stay closed, so it spends the same time in culture without signalling.
Interaction variant only: close the pair valves again, so each chamber's sample is its own.
Detach the cells from the chamber floors.
Cells out through m1_out_1/2/3, on their way to cell prep (Module 1b).
